course.learningOutcomes: Be able to know, understand, explain and apply knowledge for repair aircraft structure sheet metal by rivet fastener including sheet metal work repair methods and structure repair manual and have a good attitude to work neatly, be patience with work, a habit of working carefully and safety.
course.objectives:
1. Be able to know and understand the repair aircraft structure sheet metal by rivet fastener including sheet metal work repair methods and structure repair manual.
2. Be able to explain the repair aircraft structure sheet metal by rivet fastener including sheet metal work repair methods and structure repair manual.
3. Have a good attitude to work neatly, be patience with work, a habit of working carefully and safety.
4. Be able to apply knowledge for repair aircraft structure sheet metal by rivet fastener including sheet metal work repair methods and structure repair manual.
course.competencies:
1. Describe and codify knowledge about the repair aircraft structure sheet metal by rivet fastener including sheet metal work repair methods and structure repair manual.
2. Apply knowledge for repair aircraft structure sheet metal by rivet fastener including sheet metal work repair methods and structure repair manual.
3. Apply their knowledge of for repair aircraft structure sheet metal by rivet fastener including sheet metal work repair methods and structure repair manual in higher education.
course.description: To study and practice about the repair aircraft structure sheet metal by rivet fastener, rivet joint, rivet space, rivet pitch, rivet tools and inspection of repair joint, rivet lay-out including sheet metal work repair methods, repair tools and structure repair manual.

matches.uocTitle: Remove and install engines and engine system components.
matches.criterion: 01.01 Aircraft is prepared and supported and rendered safe in accordance with the applicable maintenance manual and isolation tags are fitted, where necessary, to ensure the safety of personnel and freedom from damage during engine removal , and removal is carried out in accordance with the applicable maintenance manual while observing all relevant work health and safety (WHS) requirements, including the use of material safety data sheets (MSDS) and items of personal protective equipment (PPE).
matches.locator: ระดับ 3 / UoC 101317 / EoC 101317.01 / PC ลำดับ 1

matches.uocTitle: Inspect and maintain structures and related components of non-pressurized.
matches.criterion: 01.01 Aircraft structure visually or physically checked for signs of defects of deformation or damage in accordance with maintenance documentation and procedures approved, while observing all requirements of relevant occupational health and safety (WHS), including the use of safety data sheets (MSDS) and items of personal protective equipment (PPE), and damage or defects are assessed against damage or wear limits specified by structural repair manual or other approved data to determine if repair or replacement is required.
